specificFindings: Feared as well as loved retains both reactions to Shaq as a player, not a universal judgement about every observer or all private life.
Unlike contrasts work-intensity reputation; known for is not direct measurement of every hour. Shaqs interview first person refers to his family responsibilities, not the interviewer or Kobe.
Whimsical adds relaxed playful imagination without implying no discipline or obligations. Both plenty successful permits different paths, not identical awards or one compulsory timetable.

Ohtani2018 rookie/2021and2023MVP and Shaq1993rookie/2000MVP/fourNBAchampionships remain separate book-reported award lists, not current verified records or evidence playfulness alone caused every honour.
Work ethic is acknowledged as critical before Even so introduces playfulness as a possibly underrated long-term contributor; the paragraph does not recommend abandoning effort.
The empirical-evidence question moves from athlete illustrations toward research. More intensely than anyone I know limits Proyer comparison to the authors knowledge, not a global researcher census.
The quoted openness-to-looking-foolish description includes less concern about competence,self-importance,sacred norms and enjoyment of ambiguity. This is not a licence to harm or abolish every rule.

Proyer2013 slightly-more-satisfied retains small magnitude,group comparison and study attribution. Nature versus vacation preferences are the reported contrasts, not universal bans or proof happy and playful people are mutually exclusive.
The2013 comparison is not relabeled as the later randomly assigned one-week counting task. Recent remains tied to the books narration period.

Like playfulness introduces spontaneity as another possible enrichment. Sitcom and Samantha references are imagined illustrative worlds rather than rights to enter real peoples apartments or guaranteed advice.
The reflective last-time question does not fabricate a real user outing. Wife sometimes when possible differs from friends not for years and the authors past graduate-school coffee routine.

The Minnesota office visit precedes the colleagues two-week-later suggestion. Right now is an immediate time limit, not refusal forever. I thought marks the narrators interpretation rather than controlled evidence for every professor.
Not just busy but protective adds active guarding of time. Highly scheduled time means an era with filled calendars; packed is metaphorical and few spontaneous opportunities is not absolutely none.

Further limited means additional constraint beyond packed schedules; the pandemic-era claim is the authors historical discussion, not a fresh global assessment or claim remote teams never communicate.

The Hinds-Mortensen sample is49 teams within the R&D division of one multinational corporation, not49 corporations or randomly assigned individuals. Generalisation and causal guarantees are not added.

All13 inherited parent English/Chinese pairs were read from compact source preview and checked for full translation, interview speakers, temporal scope, associations versus interventions, references and organisational sample boundaries.

Questions1–24 retain exact relevant parent context;25 uses only its exact sample sentence, leaving future unassigned results or conclusions pending where applicable. The planned-evidence guard passes and published fingerprints remain unchanged.
